This was head coach [[Chris Mack (basketball)|Chris Mack]]'s first season at Xavier. The Musketeers competed in the [[2009–10 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|Atlantic 10 Conference]] and played their home games at the [[Cintas Center]]. Xavier finished the season with a record of 26–9; 14–2 in [[2009–10 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to capture a share of the regular season championship with [[2009–10 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Temple]]. The Musketeers lost in the semifinals of the [[2010 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament]] to [[2009–10 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]]. Xavier received an at-large bid to the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], as a #6 seed. They defeated [[2009–10 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]] and [[2009–10 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen. In the Sweet Sixteen, they fell to [[2009–10 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] in double overtime. ==Previous season== The [[2008–09 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Musketeers]] finished the [[2008–09 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2008–09 season]] with a record of 26–9, 14–2 win the [[2008–09 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 regular season]] championship. The Musketeers lost to [[Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball|Saint Joseph's]] in the [[2009 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]]. Xavier received a #4 seed in the [[2009 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they advanced to the Sweet Sixteen before losing to [[2008–09 Pittsburgh Panthers men's
